reviews.review_description:
My first impression... this is IMPOSSIBLE!!  WAAAY too many enemies that are too strong.
 
But once I got the hang of it... it's easy (stay by the door, but move before the explosion)...  Until the next level, which is IMPOSSIBLE!!
 
There are SOO many enemies, even on Normal.  What are they anyway?  Not Zombies.. not aliens..
 
The unlock for drop to inventory should have just been active, not an unlock, its a must.  Get it ASAP.
 
It's both fun and challenging.  I keep coming back, blowing up a dozen or so at once with explosions is amazing!!  It needs a way to continue a level where I left off if I quit partway through a run.
